# Tawheed Malkat (توحيد ملقط)

> Senior product designer (UI/UX) and informatics engineer from Damascus, Syria. 4+ years designing web and mobile products with teams in Syria, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Germany. The site is in Arabic and English.
